koota.reason: koota 0.6.6 generates its SoA trait accessors with `new Function`, which the sandboxed project-frame CSP (script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval') refuses at module scope, crashing app boot. Vendored as a file: dependency with only the four accessor factories rewritten to semantically identical closures; verified against the pristine registry tarball.
koota.patch: dist/chunk-ZWIGMIL4.js, dist/index.cjs, dist/react.cjs: createSoASetFunction, createSoAFastSetFunction, createSoAFastSetChangeFunction, createSoAGetFunction rewritten from `new Function` code generation to closures with identical semantics (partial-merge set, unconditional fastSet, per-key strict-inequality change detection, fresh-object get in Object.keys order). package.json: upstream build-only devDependencies and scripts removed (private-registry refs); runtime exports untouched.
